description: Excel's pairwise accent rule on texts with several accented letters, marks shared across a letter boundary, equal-sum mark runs that share a prefix, and the accent pass against the case and skipped-character passes (T-3304). Data!A1:A20 (several accented letters on "ae"), B1:B18 (marks around "ab", across the letter boundary), C1:C23 (equal sums sharing a prefix on "a" and "ab"), D1:D20 (case, hyphen and apostrophe on "ab"); sheet G<k> holds every pair of Data column k: G<k>!<col j+1><row i> = (x<y)+2*(x=y)+4*(x>y) for x = row i, y = row j. Rank!A:D = SUMPRODUCT(--(column<x)) and Rank!E:H = COUNTIF(column,"="&x) for each text of Data columns A:D.
